content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Date: 23.07.2026 Online Application Start Date: 27.07.2026 Last Date to Apply Online: 26.08.2026

content_sections.heading: Assam Agricultural University KVK Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 33 posts are on offer across KVKs under AAU. The category-wise vacancy and reservation breakup is given below.

content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements, including educational qualification and experience, vary by post. Only Indian citizens can apply. Candidates who are permanent residents of Assam should apply only for posts other than Senior Scientist and Head (Sl. No. 1).

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral degree in the relevant field of Agriculture/Animal Science/Fisheries/Community Science/Horticulture/Sericulture with 8 years' experience (excluding the period spent obtaining the Ph.D.) as Scientist/Lecturer/Extension Specialist or an equivalent position in Pay Band 3 (Rs. 15,600-39,100) with grade pay of Rs. 5,400/6,000/7,000/8,000 (6th CPC), with contributions to research/teaching/extension education evidenced by published work/innovations and impact. Desirable: specialization in implementing extension education programmes.
Master's degree in Agriculture/Animal Science/Fisheries Science from a recognized University.
Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Animal Science/Fishery Science/Horticulture/Sericulture from a recognized University.
Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Animal Science/Fishery Science/Community Science/Horticulture/Sericulture from a recognized University.
Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science/Computer Application/Information Technology) or equivalent from a recognized University.
Bachelor's Degree in any subject from a recognized University with 5 years' work experience in Accounts and establishment.

Bachelor's degree from a recognized University with working knowledge of computer (minimum 6-month Diploma in Computer Application). Candidates must also clear a dictation test in English at 80 w.p.m. for 10 minutes and transcribe it on computer within 50 minutes.

Passed HSLC or equivalent examination from a recognized board; driving license for both heavy and light vehicles (subject to a practical skill test); two years' driving experience. Desirable: one-year trade certificate from ITI and experience in motor mechanic work.
Matriculation or equivalent pass, or ITI pass.

content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: General/OBC Candidates: Rs. 1,000/- SC/ST/PWD Candidates: Rs. 500/- The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online along with the application. No offline fee payment mode is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a detailed selection process (such as written exam pattern or interview stages) for most posts. The only assessment detail mentioned is for the post of Stenographer Grade-III, where candidates will be given a dictation test in English at 80 w.p.m. for 10 minutes and will need to transcribe the matter on computer within 50 minutes. For all other posts, the selection process is not specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: The official notification does not list specific documents required at the time of application. Candidates are advised to check the detailed instructions on the official AAU website and application portal once the online form is live.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official AAU recruitment portal at https://online.aau.ac.in/kvk-recruitment-2-2026/ . Applications can be submitted online from 27.07.2026. Fill in the application form in the prescribed online format. Pay the non-refundable application fee online (Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC, Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/PWD). Submit the application on or before the last date, 26.08.2026.

content_sections.heading: AAU KVK Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions
content_sections.text: In-service candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their parent Department/Organization. Candidates who are permanent residents of Assam should apply only for posts other than Senior Scientist and Head (Sl. No. 1). There is no upper age limit for in-service candidates of AAU. Age relaxation for reserved categories will be as per Govt. of Assam norms. Canvassing directly or indirectly for the post will be treated as disqualification. Full details on the number of posts and eligibility criteria are available on the AAU website, www.aau.ac.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 26.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 33 vacancies across nine post categories under the Krishi Vigyan Kendras of Assam Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates, payable online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 47 years for Senior Scientist-cum-Head, 38 years for Subject Matter Specialist, Programme Assistant (Lab. Technician/Computer), and Farm Manager, and 40 years for Assistant, Stenographer Grade-III, Driver, and Supporting Staff, all as on 01.01.2026. There is no upper age limit for in-service AAU candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Subject Matter Specialist in AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The initial pay for Subject Matter Specialist (T6) is Rs. 56,100/- as per Level 10 in the Pay Matrix under 7th Pay, ICAR norms.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from outside Assam apply for AAU KVK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only the post of Senior Scientist and Head (Sl. No. 1) is open to candidates who are not permanent residents of Assam; all other posts are open only to permanent residents of Assam.
